points.description: Names about three of the four philosophies: Conservationism, Preservationism, Deep Ecology, Social Ecology (any wording or close synonym, e.g. 'conservation', 'preservation', 'deep ecological', 'social ecological').
points.partial_credit: 1 mark for naming one or two of the four philosophies.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) if the student names at least three of the four: conservationism, preservationism, deep ecology, social ecology, in any wording. Give 1 mark for one or two correct names. Give 0 if none are correct or the answer is unrelated; extra wrong items do not cost marks.
